You don’t qualify for the EITC if you are someone else’s qualifying child for the EITC.

You don't qualify for the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC)

You can claim the EIC if you are married, not filing a joint return, had a qualifying child who lived with you for more than half of , and either of the following apply:

  • You lived apart from your spouse for the last 6 months of , or
  • You are legally separated according to your state law under a written separation agreement, or a decree of separate maintenance and you didn't live in the same household as your spouse at the end of .

facts.name: EITC phase out rate

facts.description: The maximum amount of EITC that can be received based on the taxpayer's AGI.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/maxEitcFromAGI">
  <Description>The maximum amount of EITC that can be received based on the taxpayer's AGI.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Subtract>
      <Minuend>
        <Dependency path="/eitcMaxCredit"/>
      </Minuend>
      <Subtrahends>
        <Switch>
          <Case>
            <When>
              <GreaterThan>
                <Left>
                  <Add>
                    <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseOutThreshold"/>
                    <Dollar>25</Dollar>
                  </Add>
                </Left>
                <Right>
                  <Dependency path="/eitcRoundedAGI"/>
                </Right>
              </GreaterThan>
            </When>
            <Then>
              <Dollar>0</Dollar>
            </Then>
          </Case>
          <Case>
            <When>
              <True/>
            </When>
            <Then>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseOutRate"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <LesserOf>
                      <Dependency path="/eitcRoundedAGI"/>
                      <Divide>
                        <Dividend>
                          <Add>
                            <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseoutAmountLowerBound"/>
                            <Dependency path="/eitcCompletedPhaseoutAmount"/>
                          </Add>
                        </Dividend>
                        <Divisors>
                          <Int>2</Int>
                        </Divisors>
                      </Divide>
                    </LesserOf>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseOutThreshold"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
            </Then>
          </Case>
        </Switch>
      </Subtrahends>
    </Subtract>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Rounded earned income for EITC without combat pay

facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/eitcRoundedEarnedIncome">

facts.name: Fails EITC age band without qualifying children (age range buckets)
facts.description: True when no one in scope is in the "Between 25 and 64" age band at the end of the tax year, for purposes of the EITC without a qualifying child. Uses /ageRange and /ageRangeSecondary only (not DOB). When MFJ and the flow collects spouse age (/flowShouldSeeSpouseAgeRange), either filer in that band passes; otherwise only the primary filer's /ageRange is used.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/failsEitcAgeBandWithoutQualifyingChildren">
  <Name>Fails EITC age band without qualifying children (age range buckets)</Name>
  <Description>True when no one in scope is in the "Between 25 and 64" age band at the end of the tax year,
                for purposes of the EITC without a qualifying child. Uses /ageRange and /ageRangeSecondary only
                (not DOB). When MFJ and the flow collects spouse age (/flowShouldSeeSpouseAgeRange), either
                filer in that band passes; otherwise only the primary filer's /ageRange is used.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
            <Dependency path="/flowShouldSeeSpouseAgeRange"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <All>
            <IsComplete>
              <Dependency path="/ageRange"/>
            </IsComplete>
            <IsComplete>
              <Dependency path="/ageRangeSecondary"/>
            </IsComplete>
            <Not>
              <Any>
                <Equal>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="/ageRange"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Enum optionsPath="/ageRangeOptions">age25to64</Enum>
                  </Right>
                </Equal>
                <Equal>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="/ageRangeSecondary"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Enum optionsPath="/ageRangeOptions">age25to64</Enum>
                  </Right>
                </Equal>
              </Any>
            </Not>
          </All>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <All>
            <IsComplete>
              <Dependency path="/ageRange"/>
            </IsComplete>
            <Not>
              <Equal>
                <Left>
                  <Dependency path="/ageRange"/>
                </Left>
                <Right>
                  <Enum optionsPath="/ageRangeOptions">age25to64</Enum>
                </Right>
              </Equal>
            </Not>
          </All>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

Uses /isFilingStatusSingle when /filingStatus is complete. For-disqualifier only; does not change /isMarried or /maybeEligibleForEitcWithoutQc.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/filingAllowsEitcWithoutQualifyingChildrenForDisqualifier">
  <Name>Filing status allows EITC without qualifying children (for disqualifier)</Name>
  <Description>Mirrors the MFJ-or-not-married intent of /maybeEligibleForEitcWithoutQc without relying on

                when /filingStatus is complete. For-disqualifier only; does not change /isMarried or

            </Right>
          </Equal>
          <Equal>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/initialFilingStatus"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Enum optionsPath="/filingStatusOptions">qualifiedSurvivingSpouse</Enum>
            </Right>
          </Equal>
        </Any>
      </All>
      <All>

        <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusSingle"/>
      </All>
    </Any>
  </Derived>

Used so /maybeEligibleForEitc cannot read as eligible when the household list is resolved but no EITC QCs remain. Gating on a complete /familyAndHousehold avoids treating an unset collection as “zero children” mid-flow.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/flowDisqualifiedEitcZeroEitcChildrenWhenQcEntryRequired">
  <Name>Results guard: QC entry cohort but zero EITC qualifying children</Name>
  <Description>True when /flowCohortEitcRequiresQualifyingChildEntry applies (user must enter at least one EITC QC story),

                read as eligible when the household list is resolved but no EITC QCs remain. Gating on a complete
                /familyAndHousehold avoids treating an unset collection as &#x201C;zero children&#x201D; mid-flow.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/flowCohortEitcRequiresQualifyingChildEntry"/>
      <IsComplete>
        <Dependency path="/familyAndHousehold"/>
      </IsComplete>
      <Equal>
        <Left>

    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/flowFamilyAndHouseholdEmptyForQcGating">
  <Name>QC flow: household has no member rows (unset or empty collection)</Name>
  <Description>True when /familyAndHousehold is not yet complete in the graph, or is complete with zero UUIDs. Used so
        Qualifying Children knockouts do not require client-side initialization of an empty Collection.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Any>
      <Not>
        <IsComplete>
          <Dependency path="/familyAndHousehold"/>
        </IsComplete>
      </Not>
      <All>
        <IsComplete>
          <Dependency path="/familyAndHousehold"/>
        </IsComplete>
        <Equal>
          <Left>
            <CollectionSize>
              <Dependency path="/familyAndHousehold"/>
            </CollectionSize>
          </Left>
          <Right>
            <Int>0</Int>
          </Right>
        </Equal>
      </All>
    </Any>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Flow cohort: must have an EITC qualifying child when claiming QC (Single/QSS/MFJ age; MFS; HOH)
facts.description: True when the taxpayer completed and answered yes to claiming EITC qualifying children, and any of: (1) Single, QSS, or MFJ and outside the 25–64 age band for EITC without a qualifying child (same basis as /failsEitcAgeBandWithoutQualifyingChildren); (2) Married Filing Separately; (3) Head of Household and married (considered married for HOH); or (4) Head of Household not married (Are you married? No) and outside the 25–64 age band for EITC without a qualifying child. MFS and either HOH variant cannot use EITC without a qualifying child under flow rules and must enter at least one EITC QC story on Qualifying Children.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/flowCohortEitcRequiresQualifyingChildEntry">
  <Name>Flow cohort: must have an EITC qualifying child when claiming QC (Single/QSS/MFJ age; MFS; HOH)</Name>
  <Description>True when the taxpayer completed and answered yes to claiming EITC qualifying children, and any of:
        (1) Single, QSS, or MFJ and outside the 25&#x2013;64 age band for EITC without a qualifying child
        (same basis as /failsEitcAgeBandWithoutQualifyingChildren); (2) Married Filing Separately;
        (3) Head of Household and married (considered married for HOH); or (4) Head of Household not married
        (Are you married? No) and outside the 25&#x2013;64 age band for EITC without a qualifying child.
        MFS and either HOH variant cannot use EITC without a qualifying child under flow rules and must enter
        at least one EITC QC story on Qualifying Children.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <IsComplete>
        <Dependency path="/primaryFilerIsClaimingQualifyingChildren"/>
      </IsComplete>
      <Dependency path="/primaryFilerIsClaimingQualifyingChildren"/>
      <Any>
        <All>
          <Any>
            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusSingle"/>
            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusQSS"/>
            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
          </Any>
          <Dependency path="/failsEitcAgeBandWithoutQualifyingChildren"/>
        </All>
        <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFS"/>
        <All>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusHOH"/>
          <Dependency path="/isHOHMarried"/>
        </All>
        <All>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusHOH"/>
          <IsComplete>
            <Dependency path="/isHOHMarried"/>
          </IsComplete>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/isHOHMarried"/>
          </Not>
          <Dependency path="/failsEitcAgeBandWithoutQualifyingChildren"/>
        </All>
      </Any>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Show QC flow knockout: add a child (empty household)
facts.description: True when the cohort must enter at least one qualifying child for EITC and there are no EITC qualifying children yet, either because no household rows exist yet or because entered rows do not qualify for EITC.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/flowShouldShowQcRequiredAddChildKnockout">
  <Name>Show QC flow knockout: add a child (empty household)</Name>
  <Description>True when the cohort must enter at least one qualifying child for EITC and there are no EITC qualifying

  <Derived>

facts.name: Filing status that can be represented to the user in the flow, with correct spacing and casing
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/flowReadableFilingStatus">
  <Name>Filing status that can be represented to the user in the flow, with correct spacing and casing</Name>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <String>Married Filing Jointly</String>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFS"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <String>Married Filing Separately</String>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusSingle"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <String>Single</String>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusHOH"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <String>Head of Household</String>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusQSS"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <String>Qualifying Surviving Spouse</String>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/derivedFilingStatus">
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/tentativelyHOHFromHomeUpkeep"/>
            <Any>
              <Dependency path="/isSingle"/>
              <Dependency path="/isDivorcedOrLegallySeparated"/>
              <Dependency path="/isWidowedAtLeastTwoTaxYearsAgo"/>
              <All>
                <Dependency path="/isWidowedInPastTwoTaxYears"/>
                <IsComplete>
                  <Dependency path="/couldClaimChildAsDependentInCurrentTaxYearWithExceptions"/>
                </IsComplete>
                <Not>
                  <Dependency path="/couldClaimChildAsDependentInCurrentTaxYearWithExceptions"/>
                </Not>
              </All>
              <All>
                <Dependency path="/isWidowedInPastTwoTaxYears"/>
                <Not>
                  <Dependency path="/entitledToPreviouslyFileJointReturn"/>
                </Not>
              </All>
              <All>
                <Dependency path="/isWidowedInPastTwoTaxYears"/>
                <Dependency path="/entitledToPreviouslyFileJointReturn"/>
                <Not>
                  <Dependency path="/paidMoreThanHalfHomeCostsForChild"/>
                </Not>
              </All>
            </Any>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Enum optionsPath="/filingStatusOptions">headOfHousehold</Enum>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Not>
              <Dependency path="/tentativelyHOHFromHomeUpkeep"/>
            </Not>
            <Any>
              <Dependency path="/isSingle"/>
              <Dependency path="/isDivorcedOrLegallySeparated"/>
              <Dependency path="/isWidowedAtLeastTwoTaxYearsAgo"/>
              <All>
                <Dependency path="/isWidowedInPastTwoTaxYears"/>
                <IsComplete>
                  <Dependency path="/couldClaimChildAsDependentInCurrentTaxYearWithExceptions"/>
                </IsComplete>
                <Not>
                  <Dependency path="/couldClaimChildAsDependentInCurrentTaxYearWithExceptions"/>
                </Not>
              </All>
              <All>
                <Dependency path="/isWidowedInPastTwoTaxYears"/>
                <Not>
                  <Dependency path="/entitledToPreviouslyFileJointReturn"/>
                </Not>
              </All>
              <All>
                <Dependency path="/isWidowedInPastTwoTaxYears"/>
                <Dependency path="/entitledToPreviouslyFileJointReturn"/>
                <Not>
                  <Dependency path="/paidMoreThanHalfHomeCostsForChild"/>
                </Not>
              </All>
            </Any>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Enum optionsPath="/filingStatusOptions">single</Enum>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/maritalStatusAllowsFilingMarried"/>
            <Dependency path="/intendsToFileJointly"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Enum optionsPath="/filingStatusOptions">marriedFilingJointly</Enum>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/maritalStatusAllowsFilingMarried"/>
            <Not>
              <Dependency path="/intendsToFileJointly"/>
            </Not>
            <Dependency path="/spouseLivedWithTaxpayerLastSixMonths"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Enum optionsPath="/filingStatusOptions">marriedFilingSeparately</Enum>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/maritalStatusAllowsFilingMarried"/>
            <Not>
              <All>
                <Dependency path="/intendsToFileJointly"/>
                <Dependency path="/spouseLivedWithTaxpayerLastSixMonths"/>
              </All>
            </Not>
            <Dependency path="/paidMoreThanHalfHomeCostsForChild"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Enum optionsPath="/filingStatusOptions">headOfHousehold</Enum>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/maritalStatusAllowsFilingMarried"/>
            <Not>
              <Dependency path="/intendsToFileJointly"/>
            </Not>
            <Not>
              <Dependency path="/spouseLivedWithTaxpayerLastSixMonths"/>
            </Not>
            <Not>
              <Dependency path="/paidMoreThanHalfHomeCostsForChild"/>
            </Not>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Enum optionsPath="/filingStatusOptions">marriedFilingSeparately</Enum>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/isWidowedInTaxYear"/>
            <Not>
              <Dependency path="/intendsToFileJointly"/>
            </Not>
            <Dependency path="/spouseLivedWithTaxpayerLastSixMonths"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Enum optionsPath="/filingStatusOptions">marriedFilingSeparately</Enum>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Any>
            <All>

If SSA MAGI (Line 8) is less than $32K for MFJ and $25K for anybody else, 0% of SSA benefits are taxed. This is our bracket zero. Taxable portion of SSA MAGI which is more than bracket zero but less than $32K + $12K for MFJ and $25K + $9K for everyone else, is 50%, not to exceed 50% of SSA Benefits total. Taxable portion of SSA MAGI which is more than $32K + $12K for MFJ and $25K + $9K for everyone else, is 85%, not to exceed 85% of SSA Benefits total. If TP is MFS which lived together for any part of the year, all SSA Benefits are taxed at 85%.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/pub915BracketZeroLine9">
  <Description>Threshold when taxable portion of SSA Benefits changes from 0% to 50%. Pub 915
        Worksheet 1, Line 9.
        If SSA MAGI (Line 8) is less than $32K for MFJ and $25K for anybody else, 0% of SSA benefits
        are taxed. This is our bracket zero.
        Taxable portion of SSA MAGI which is more than bracket zero but less than $32K + $12K for
        MFJ and $25K + $9K for everyone else, is 50%, not to exceed 50% of SSA Benefits total.
        Taxable portion of SSA MAGI which is more than $32K + $12K for MFJ and $25K + $9K for
        everyone else, is 85%, not to exceed 85% of SSA Benefits total.
        If TP is MFS which lived together for any part of the year, all SSA Benefits are taxed at
        85%.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>32000</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>

            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFS"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>

        </When>

facts.name: Student Loan Amount Phase Out Multiplier
facts.description: Phaseout amount for the student loan deduction. Described in instructions for 1040, schedule 1, line 21. Corresponds with Line 8 of the Student Loan Interest Deduction Worksheet. Returns 0 if there is no phaseout
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/studentLoanAmountPhaseOutAmount">
  <Name>Student Loan Amount Phase Out Multiplier</Name>
  <Description>Phaseout amount for the student loan deduction. Described in instructions for 1040, schedule
        1, line 21. Corresponds with Line 8 of the Student Loan Interest Deduction Worksheet.
        Returns 0 if there is no phaseout</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Divide>
      <Dividend>
        <Multiply>
          <Divide>
            <Dividend>
              <Multiply>
                <GreaterOf>
                  <Subtract>
                    <Minuend>
                      <Dependency path="/magiForStudentLoanInterestDeduction"/>
                    </Minuend>
                    <Subtrahends>
                      <Dependency path="/studentLoanPhaseOutStart"/>
                    </Subtrahends>
                  </Subtract>
                  <Dollar>0</Dollar>
                </GreaterOf>
                <Dollar>10</Dollar>
              </Multiply>
            </Dividend>
            <Divisors>
              <Dependency path="/studentLoanPhaseOutRange"/>
            </Divisors>
          </Divide>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/studentLoanInterestAmount"/>
            <Dependency path="/maxStudentLoanDeduction"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Multiply>
      </Dividend>
      <Divisors>
        <Dollar>10</Dollar>
      </Divisors>
    </Divide>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Student Loan Interest Deduction Amount
facts.description: The amount of the student loan interest deduction. Line 21 of Form 1040 Schedule 1, Line 33 Calculated per requirements on Student Loan Interest Deduction Worksheet
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/studentLoanInterestDeduction">
  <Name>Student Loan Interest Deduction Amount</Name>
  <Description>The amount of the student loan interest deduction. Line 21 of Form 1040 Schedule 1, Line 33
        Calculated per requirements on Student Loan Interest Deduction Worksheet</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Not>
              <Dependency path="/isEligibleForStudentLoanInterestDeduction"/>
            </Not>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Subtract>
              <Minuend>
                <LesserOf>
                  <Dependency path="/studentLoanInterestAmount"/>
                  <Dependency path="/maxStudentLoanDeduction"/>
                </LesserOf>
              </Minuend>
              <Subtrahends>
                <Dependency path="/studentLoanAmountPhaseOutAmount"/>
              </Subtrahends>
            </Subtract>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>
